file.description: path; empty string if not applicable

whereChecked.description: OFF-SITE EVIDENCE: the file:line you actually opened to establish a load-bearing premise that lives OUTSIDE the cited defect site — a dependency's behaviour, reachability from an entry point, the absence of a guard in a caller, what a sibling path does. Several may be comma-separated, each with a few words on what it shows. Empty string ONLY when the finding is fully self-contained at the cited file:line and rests on no off-site claim

blastRadius.description: callers affected / breaking-change note; empty if n/a

source.description: lens name or tool name that produced this

ruleId.description: catalog rule ID from the active profile's rules.md (e.g. "CON-003" for rust, "PUR-001" for nix) if the finding maps to one; empty string otherwise

toolRule.description: gate seeds only: the tool's own rule name copied from the tool output line that names it (clippy lint "clippy::needless_pass_by_value", semgrep rule id, statix code, semver-checks check name) — never from memory; omit when the output names none or the finding is not a tool's

fp.description: line-tolerant fingerprint; empty if not from a ledger

symbol.description: enclosing fn/type name; empty if unknown

deletionOrRecoveryPath.description: reconciler and failure-windows lenses only: true when the defect sits on a deletion or recovery path (finalizer removal, teardown, a delete handler, crash or partial-failure recovery); omit otherwise

externalSystem.description: the external system (another project's controller, API server or service, not a library dependency) whose behaviour the finding's premise rests on, by its name; omit when none

harm.description: the harm this finding names: its effect, who is affected, and how they recover (by itself, by retry, by an operator's hand, not at all)

harmLevel.description: the `harmLevel` column of the first row of the review-rules severity.md table (read top down, worst first) the harm honestly fills; the engine caps severity at that row's ceiling

repoRule.description: harmLevel repo-rule only: the reviewed repository's written rule this finding breaks — omit otherwise

file.description: the repository file that states the rule (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, a documented convention), as a path from the repo root

text.description: the rule, quoted from that file
